input:
Title: Add user search endpoint

Files changed (1):
  src/api/search.py (+18/-0)

Diff:
+def search(user_id):
+    q = 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ' + user_id
+    return db.execute(q)

No auth or migration files are touched, but the query is assembled by string concatenation of the request input. Linked issue #260. CI: green.

Triage result: {"escalate": true, "risk": "HIGH", "signals": ["sql-injection"], "summary": "query built by string concatenation"}

key_findings: SQL query is built by string concatenation of untrusted input (search(user_id) -> 'SELECT ... WHERE id = ' + user_id), a SQL-injection anti-pattern
recommend a parameterized/prepared query instead of concatenation
